method: Renders r_w8 (q02-q05 930x575; s1-s6 and v1-v5 640x480) compared with r_head, omaat_f5, f9, f11, f32, f57, f58, f60 and the official f_17313 / f_17314. Colours are PIL box means, compared as ratios inside one image. Sizes are scaled from the 0.952 x 0.535 m screen glass. Code: src/09d_suite.js at d14b24c (327 lines).

calibration.earlier_issue: w7a MED: the window-wing rounded corner was hidden behind a square shell and cap
calibration.status: fixed. Lines 48-55 build the shell (r 0.10) and the cap rim (r 0.115) as arcs, and start the cap at rc. s2, q03 and q05 show a rounded outer top corner with the taupe rim running down the outer edge, as in omaat_f11 / f60.

calibration.earlier_issue: w7a MED / w7b out-of-scope: the keypad rendered 1.4-1.6x the console
calibration.status: mostly fixed. Line 161 is #4a4642 r 0.6 and the glyphs no longer glow. Keypad/module is 0.93 in s4 (L154/165) and 0.93 in q02 (L117/126); real omaat_f58 is 0.87. In the sunlit q04 it is still 1.0 (L158/157), which is the sun patch: lighting.

calibration.earlier_issue: w7a MED: the bed duvet was invisible
calibration.status: partly fixed. Lines 275-280 loft the duvet and add a fold band, a drape and creases. The fold band reads in q04, s5 and v2. But the three crease boxes (line 280) render as light rods lying on the duvet, like chopsticks (q04 crop), and the band is a whiter separate slab (#ece9e3 against duvet #dcd8d0). See issues.

calibration.earlier_issue: w7a MED: the console was one flat level; real has a raised aft module and a window ledge
calibration.status: fixed in massing (lines 156-157), but see the new issue: the keypad and handset lie nearly flat (-12 deg) on a slab top. Real faces slope at about 40-60 deg toward the seat (omaat_f5, f57, f_17313).

calibration.earlier_issue: w7a LOW / w7b LOW: the fluted field was warm brown
calibration.status: fixed in hue. v1 field #74705d (R-G +4, B -23) against f60 #4a4937. Still too LIGHT: cap/field is 1.71 in v1 vs 2.31 in f60, and field/flank is 2.85 vs 1.67 (see issues).

calibration.earlier_issue: w7a LOW: the niche header was thin with square corners
calibration.status: fixed. Line 258 makes a 0.09 header and lines 259-263 add r 0.035 fillets. f9 header is about 0.10 with about 0.045 radii; s4 reads close.

calibration.earlier_issue: w7a LOW: red status LEDs were missing
calibration.status: fixed (line 235). v1 shows red dots at both leaves' top outer corners, as in f60.

calibration.earlier_issue: w7a LOW: the s2 / v4 studio cameras were blocked by the aft wall
calibration.status: fixed. s2 and v4 now look from the seat at the screen wall.

calibration.earlier_issue: w7a LOW out of scope: cream caps under cabin light, large navy plaque, hard sun patches
calibration.status: not fixed (other owners). The q02 cap is #b7b1a4 at 4.2x the fin board vs f32 hood/board 2.65. The 1A plaque in q04 is still a large navy tile. The sun patches in q04 are hard-edged.

calibration.earlier_issue: w7b MED: the pier lamp overlapped the mirror
calibration.status: fixed (lines 97-100). In the q03 crop the lamp ring sits clear, outboard of the mirror's top. Side effect: the window mirror shrank to mW = pw - 0.10 = 0.103 (see issues).

calibration.earlier_issue: w7b MED: the far LOD disagreed with the near unit
calibration.status: fixed (lines 308-326): lowered divider, matched screen position, caps, leaf panels and flank. In v5 the massing matches. It still has no window wing or pier wood (minor).

calibration.earlier_issue: w7b MED: the centre pier projected narrow from the aisle
calibration.status: NOT fixed / slightly regressed from the aisle. pAng is 74 deg (line 90), so pw = 0.236, but the steeper face now turns to the seat. In q02 the 2D pier projects 0.41 of the screen height vs 0.83 in f32. The 2D mirror projects 0.18 of the screen height wide vs 0.36 in f32 (w7b measured 0.22).

calibration.earlier_issue: w7b LOW: dashed seam on the centre fin's aft edge
calibration.status: partly fixed. The 2 mm overlap (lines 84-85) shortened the dashes, but the q02 crop still shows a broken dark line in the upper half. The 4 mm edge radius exceeds the 2 mm overlap, so a groove remains.

calibration.earlier_issue: w7b LOW: moire on the forward leaf at grazing angles
calibration.status: improved. fFluteGap is now 0.8x the slat (line 18). s1 shows fine slats with no diamond pattern; q05 shows only mild shimmer.

calibration.earlier_issue: w7b LOW: the flanks were too light
calibration.status: fixed / overshot. fFlank #2a221d (line 19) renders #2f231e. It now matches f60 against the cap (flank/cap 0.21 vs 0.26). Against the field it reads too dark only because the field is too light.

calibration.earlier_issue: w7b LOW: the pier dipped 2 cm into the aisle box
w7b LOW: the back seams rendered as light hairlines
calibration.status: fixed (line 298, #3f3a36). s4 shows three dark creases.

calibration.earlier_issue: w7b LOW: the belt stood under the pillow; the turned corner was a hairline
calibration.status: fixed. In q04 the belt lies diagonally on the bare pad between the pillows and the fold with its buckle, as in f57. The turned corner is replaced by the fold band.

details.detail: Aisle face, doors open and closed: fluted leaves, frames, pulls, LEDs, flanks
Window screen wall: rounded wing and rim, 43-in screen, cap
Centre pair: board, 2D pier and mirror, lowered and raised divider
Console: fascia, tray, raised module, keypad, handset
Seat: back, flap, seams, niche header, lamps, pillow, armrest
Bed: pad, duvet, fold, belt, pillows
Colour and materials: olive leaves, caps, wood, tweed

issues.issue: The keypad and handset lie almost flat on a slab-topped module (tilted -12 deg). On the real console both sit on a steep sculpted face sloping toward the seat, about 40-60 deg from horizontal. Above it is a thin taupe top lip, and below it the dark trough runs forward. From the seat and from the aisle the render reads as a remote on a shelf, not the sculpted fascia.
issues.evidence: omaat_f5 (2G console from the aisle): handset and keypad face the seat on a near-vertical fascia under the lip. omaat_f57: the keypad is on a ~45 deg face below the handset pod. f_17313: the handset is on the inner sloping face. Render s4 crop and q04 crop: both are horizontal tiles on a flat 0.05 slab (line 156), with the 0.075-tall window ledge (line 157) standing above them like a wall.
issues.fix: src/09d_suite.js lines 158 and 174: rotate K and Hs by -42*DEG instead of -12*DEG, and drop their origin y from 0.678 + mdy to about 0.69, so the tiles sit on the module's seat-side face. Line 156: replace the gRBox module with a wedge gExtrude([[xo+0.035,0.665],[xo+0.035,0.735],[xo+0.075,0.735],[xo+shelfW,0.69],[xo+shelfW,0.665]], 0.52) placed at z -0.94 (fConsole), so the face drops ~0.045 over ~0.11 toward the seat. Line 157: lower the ledge to height 0.05 (top 0.735, flush with the wedge top) so it reads as the lip, not a wall.

issues.issue: Bed creases render as three light rods lying on the duvet, like chopsticks. The fold band is a whiter separate slab whose end sticks out past the aisle edge. Real duvet folds are soft shading changes in the same white, not rods (omaat_f57 diagonal turned corner, f58 rumpled sheet).
issues.evidence: q04 crop (380-830, 170-470): three 0.022-wide bright sticks with hard shadow edges. The band is L239 against duvet L230 and has a square slab end beyond the drape. The crease boxes (line 280, y 0.582, h 0.012) are mostly buried in the 0.61 crown and poke out only as thin strips.
issues.fix: Line 280: delete the three crease gRBoxes. If folds are wanted, use one or two gLoft ridges 0.12 wide and 0.008 tall with soft 0.05 edges in the duvet colour. Line 278: give the band duv's colour (#dcd8d0), shorten it to dw - 0.08 so it ends inside the drape, and replace the 4 deg yaw with a diagonal turned-corner triangle (a gExtrude of [[0,0],[0.45,0],[0,0.35]], 0.03 thick at the aisle head corner, as in f57).

issues.issue: The centre (2D/2G) pier and mirror read too narrow from the aisle, and the mirror has the window suite's tall pill proportion. Real centre mirrors are shorter and wider, about 0.16 x 0.31 (ratio ~1.9). The window mirror is about 0.15 x 0.47 (ratio ~3.1).
issues.evidence: omaat_f5 2D: mirror 75 x 145 px against a 240 px screen height, about 0.17 x 0.32 m. omaat_f32 2D: 75 x 140 px against 210 px, about 0.19 x 0.36 m. Render q02 2D mirror: 0.18 of the screen height wide, 0.57 tall, a 0.13 x 0.44 tall pill (lines 97-99). The 74 deg pier (line 90) projects 0.41 of the screen height vs 0.83 in f32.
issues.fix: Line 97: const mW = center ? Math.min(0.16, pw - 0.07) : Math.min(0.13, pw - 0.10), mH = center ? 0.30 : 0.44; mX as now. Lines 98-99: use mH and mH - 0.018 for the heights and raise the centre mirror to y scy + 0.05, then move the centre lamp (line 100) to the outer top corner above it at pt(pw - 0.035, H - 0.05, 0.02). Within the 1.10 m width, relax the line 90 centre pAng 74 -> 68 so the pier turns back toward the aisle (pw = 0.065/cos68 = 0.17; mW = min(0.16, 0.10) = 0.10). This trade-off is listed under questions.

issues.issue: The window-suite mirror is narrow: 0.103 m wide (mW = pw - 0.10 with pw 0.203). Real is about 0.15 wide at 0.47 tall, and the real window pier is broader (about 0.30 projected in f11).
issues.evidence: omaat_f11: mirror 95 px and pier 185 px against a 335 px screen height, i.e. 0.15 m and 0.30 m. q03 crop: mirror ~0.10, pier ~0.23 projected.
issues.fix: Line 90: window pAng 64 -> 68 deg. Then pw = 0.089/cos68 = 0.238 and line 97 gives mW = min(0.13, 0.138) = 0.13, with the lamp at pw - 0.042 = 0.196 ± 0.037, clear of the mirror edge at 0.145.

issues.issue: The fluted field and frame are still about 1.35x too light relative to the cap and flanks, so the closed doors read as light sage rather than the dark olive-grey of f60.
issues.fix: Lines 11 and 18: fDoorFrame '#5c5a50' -> '#4c4b41', fFlute '#57554a' -> '#48473d', fFluteGap '#45433a' -> '#3a3931' (keeps groove/slat 0.8).

issues.issue: A dashed seam remains on the aft edge of the centre fin. The 2 mm per-side overlap is smaller than the 4 mm edge radius, so a V groove still aliases.
issues.evidence: q02 crop (410-510, 130-330): a broken dark line in the upper half of the 2D/2G fin edge strip; shorter than in r_head but present.
issues.fix: Lines 84-85: edge radius 0.004 -> 0.0015, or move the strips to x -hx + 0.006 (overlap 4 mm) with the same 0.020 width.

issues.issue: The handset screen is a bright sky-blue emissive patch. Real handset screens are a deep saturated blue (or show a small UI) and read darker than the white glyphs.
issues.evidence: q04 and s4 crops: #6cc0f0-ish cyan. omaat_f58 handset #172291 (L44), f57 deep blue.

issues.issue: The caps are a neutral cream-grey; real caps are warm olive-khaki. Under cabin light they also read too bright (lighting owner).
issues.evidence: q02 / q05 cap #b7b1a4 (R-B +19). omaat_f32 hood #ab946c (R-B +63), f9 cap #b5a57c (+57), f60 #afa787 (+40). Official f_17314 is cooler, so aim for the middle. q02 cap/board 4.2 vs f32 2.65.
issues.fix: fCap is used only by this unit, so override it in the Object.assign at lines 10-20: fCap: { c: '#878068', r: 0.42, l: LAYER.plastic } (R-B +31). Lighting owner: lower the fill on the cap tops.

issues.issue: The far LOD has no window wing or pier wood, so at the LOD switch the dark verticals beside the screen pop in.
issues.evidence: v5: the far unit's screen sits on a plain taupe wall; the near unit shows dark wood either side.
issues.fix: Line 325 area: add B.add(gBox(0.10, H - 0.68, 0.03), M4.trs(-hx + 0.08, 0.68 + (H - 0.68)/2, -L + 0.135), SEATMAT.fWood) for !c, and a 0.22 x (H - 0.645) fWood pier box at x scx + 0.60, rotated -66 deg.

issues.issue: Out of scope, noted only: horizontal tweed (ottoman, seat cushion) reads light beige in studio and cabin light. q03 ottoman/table 1.33, s2 2.0 vs omaat_f11 1.02 and f_17313 0.82. The 1A plaque is a large navy tile. The sun patches on the bed are hard-edged.
issues.fix: Lighting owner: less top fill on horizontal surfaces. Seats owner: 09_seats.js plaque ~0.05 x 0.03.

questions: Centre pier: in omaat_f5 and f32 the 2D pier faces the aisle broadly (about 0.4 m projected) with a short wide mirror. With the accepted 1.10 m width, should the pier stay steep (74 deg, faces the seat, narrow from the aisle) or go back to ~68 deg (narrower but aisle-facing)? Or can the centre screen be a little smaller than 43 in to free 0.05-0.08 m for the pier?
Is the default demo state of the bed meant to show the turned-down duvet corner of f57 (window suite) or the rumpled full sheet of f58? The fold band is neither.
